airframe.notes:
Built by scripts/atlas_v3_30_from_step.py from SMALL_SCALE_V3_30.step (30 Sep 2026). Masses only from the labels of the top-level component folders, spread by volume over each folder's solids; unlabelled folders weigh nothing. Foil exit angles ray-traced on this STEP: 49.5, 58.2, 49.6, 49.5, 58.2, 49.6 deg. Legs on the CAD's rear outboard feet and the front foot (nose skid). PX4 gains, fan model, H-FLOW mount and nose-lift settings from atlas_v3_v34_foils_50_65_50_tuned.json, MC_AIRMODE 0.

Tuned 2026-10-01 in SITL on 2026-10-01_1511_v3_30_cad_rotate_hover (rotate from the parked -18 deg, 60 s Stabilized hover, land): MC_PITCHRATE_P 0.75 -> 0.9, MC_PITCHRATE_I 0.1 -> 0.05. Over 3 seeds: hover pitch error 0.30 -> 0.18 deg, drift 13.4 -> 8.4 m, lift-off wobble 2.85 -> 2.47 deg, touchdown 0.28 -> 0.20 m/s. More pitch-rate integrator made the hover offset worse; MC_PITCH_P 9 oscillated.

CFD foil thrust (scripts/atlas_v3_30_cfd.py, OpenFOAM, 1 Oct 2026): per foil group [-56.12, 46.48, 0.73] N (x fan axis aft, y up, z span), foils 75 / 65 / 50 deg, at 3 x 36 N in -> each foil fan 24.29 N (67.5 %) at 39.63 deg above the duct axis; hover re-trimmed to 42.7 deg.

Jet sweep (2026-10-01T17:46:52-07:00, scripts/v3_30_jet_sweep.py): foil jets inner / middle / outer 57.5 / 85 / 85 deg above the fan axis, 67.5 % kept; hover 8.5, parked -10.0 deg.
2026-10-14: simple SITL copy of atlas_v3_30_jets_57.5_85_85_park-10: nose_lift and nose_lower disabled, so stock PX4 flies the rotation from the pilot's sticks.

Torino setup (2026-10-15T12:13:22-07:00): foils 85/85/57.5 (outer/middle/inner) on both sides, nose fans as built, parked -10, hover 8.5; nose lift/lower off; px4_overrides reduced to the fewest that fly (start: MPC_THR_HOVER only; was 29 values). Minimal set found 15 Oct (SITL, Stabilized, 3 seeds): geometry only = no lift-off (34 deg/s wobble); + THR_MDL_FAC 1 flies loosely; + MC_ROLLRATE_P 0.6 / MC_PITCHRATE_P 0.9 flies as well as the old 29-value set (settle ~1 s); + MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX 12 settles in 0.6 s with half the yaw drag. Adding angle and yaw gains made it worse (one ground hit). Renamed 15 Oct from atlas_v3_30_torino.json / ATLAS_V3_30_TORINO: this is the Current setup.
Imported from utopia-vault/airframe-designer @ feat/simple-sim-apps, airframes/atlas_v3_30_current.json (the Simple Sim app's "Current"), 2026-10-15.
